integrationGates.purpose: event-driven, taught and optimized versions compose

rules.activation: only items in the next eligible wave may activate
rules.parallel: parallel-no-rebase means same base main SHA, disjoint authoritative surfaces, no unmerged implementation dependencies, independently mergeable
rules.contractDependencies: consume merged/frozen contracts only; never consume an unmerged sibling branch
rules.integrationGates: combine already merged capabilities; use dedicated gate Work Orders with their own machine state
rules.integrationPrerequisites: a high-risk execution Work Order cannot activate until the integration gates explicitly listed in its state record are COMPLETE
rules.completion: implementation + deterministic verification + required dogfooding/conformance evidence + sole architect merge + actual merge evidence
rules.dogfooding: mandatory after every feature boundary and every integration gate; equivalent conformance is allowed only for explicitly classified non-user-facing infrastructure
rules.quality: parallelism never reduces tests, real-system proofs, security checks, or dogfooding
rules.recovery: resume from GitHub state, lastVerifiedSha and nextAction; never conversation memory
rules.scope: unrelated findings require corrective Work Orders; no drive-by fixes
rules.v1Boundary: remaining V1 work is deferred unless transition policy records a concrete V2 dependency, compatibility/security requirement, or explicit architect reactivation
rules.v2Priority: V2 is the forward product roadmap; deferred V1 work is not an implicit prerequisite
rules.architect: there is exactly one architect/reviewer; no external review role
rules.antiDrift: frozen V2 concepts may only change through a governed V2 architecture change
rules.noRebaseTax: a parallel sibling cannot require a future rebase onto another sibling; integration happens after merge via a dedicated gate
rules.roadmapLock: V2-CTRL-002 overrides informal roadmap wording if inconsistent
rules.integrationWorkOrder: every listed IG-* gate must have a repository-resident Work Order and machine-state entry before activation
rules.dogfoodingEvidence: a Work Order marked COMPLETE must reference persisted dogfooding or equivalent conformance evidence
rules.protocolRegistry: all protocol-visible capabilities, events, execution classes, placement identifiers and digest rules come from V2-CTRL-003
rules.authorization: capability advertisement, marketplace entitlement, node trust and execution authorization are distinct dimensions
rules.implementationAuthorization: V2 is approved for implementation; proposed status means the generation remains governed by the constitution until formally version-frozen
rules.executionAttestation: execution commitments, attestations, assurance and proof graphs are evidence/protocol primitives, never a second workflow, authorization, execution or verification authority
